Offline embedding refresh jobs are scheduled batch processes that regenerate vector embeddings for a corpus when the underlying embedding model changes or source documents update in bulk.

## Operational Pattern

Rather than refreshing embeddings on demand, these jobs run on a fixed cadence. They re-embed the full or incremental document set and swap the new vectors into the retrieval index atomically to avoid serving mixed-model results during the transition.

## Key Operational Concerns

**Model versioning**: Track which embedding model version was used for each batch, enabling rollback and drift detection.

**Vector drift monitoring**: Compare old and new vectors to detect quality regressions or unexpected changes in the embedding space.

**Atomic index swaps**: Stage the swap behind a blue/green index deployment so that a quality regression can be detected and rolled back without serving inconsistent results to clients.
